Keep the existing assertions: 2 players in both replicas, block edit crosses, chat round-trip, roster + owner-only Kick, kick → "Disconnected" alertdialog, zero console errors. Design the exact locator flow (AccountPanel form fields have what labels? check the component) and keep `exact: true` pitfalls in mind (past CI break: `getByRole` exact is Playwright-only… actually the past break was using `{exact}` in a component test — the point: locators must be Playwright-valid).
- `e2e/cloudSaves.e2e.ts` (:48-50 clicks "Play online as guest"): rewrite: sign UP as account → account home → "Play locally" door → local profile/world → Upload to cloud → verify Synced badge → (existing round-trip assertions — second context downloads?). Read the spec to preserve its actual assertions.
- Component tests: `components/menu/AccountPanel.test.tsx` — drop tests 1-2 (guest flows) + the `signIn.anonymous` fake + `signInAnonymousCalls`; keep/adjust sign-in/out + error tests; add: logged-out shows Sign in (no guest button). `AccountProfileSelect.test.tsx` — add Play-locally callback test; fixture `isAnonymous` field removed (type change). `OnlineWorldSelect.test.tsx` — add joined-world visibility + no-owner-actions test. `WorldSelect.test.tsx` — check what exists; adjust for removed Online Worlds section + new signedIn prop. `ProfileSelect.test.tsx` — likely fine; check.

## Docs (docs ship WITH the change — part of the verify gate)
- `docs/online.md`: rewrite "Identity: guests first" (:25-48) → accounts-only model (Local Players offline / accounts online, 5 profiles × 10 worlds, hidden-but-preserved local worlds, Play-locally door, joined worlds visible under every profile); diagram label :12 "(guests + accounts)"; :87 join-page description; :136-137 local co-op recipe (now needs two real accounts — two browser profiles each signing up).
- `docs/tuning.md:499` "guests (anonymous) can't create any" — sweep.
- `docs/testing.md`: rows 17 (guest→account upgrade / guests-barred wording), 53 ("sign in as guests"), 54 ("signed-in guest's" cloud round-trip) — update to match new tests.
- `docs/manual.md`: "Getting an identity" (:651-655) + "Joining" (:664-667) — rewrite (no guest sign-in; accounts required for online; Play locally).
- `README.md:8` "friends join as one-click guests" — update.
- `docs/save-format.md`: unchanged by decision 3 (v17 "per account" stays true). NOTE pre-existing staleness: line 5 says "version 16" while code is v17 — flag as an optional drive-by fix (separate commit).
- `docs/protocol.md`: unchanged (decision 3).
- `CHANGELOG.md` Unreleased: add Changed/Removed entries (accounts required for online; guest layer removed + guest data dropped; Play-locally door; joined worlds in account list; invite pages require sign-in). Note :13 and :17 existing entries reference the legacy guest path — the "(Guests still reach online play via the legacy path…)" parenthetical at :13 should be dropped/amended since the same Unreleased batch now removes it.

# Workflow constraints (from AGENTS.md + user memory)

- Big work → own branch off main: suggest `feat/account-only-online` (or better name), own PR.
- One conventional commit per slice, why-focused bodies, lint green per commit (bisectable). Per-commit local verify = `bun run format` + `bun run lint` ONLY (full gate is slow; CI verify covers typecheck/test/build). Before opening the PR: full local gate once (`lint`, `typecheck`, `format:check`, `bun test`, `build`) + `bun run test:e2e` (shell/UI touched). NEVER gate on `bun test | tail` (exit 99 = passed-but-leaked PGlite is expected; CI catches real leaks).
- Docs + tests + CHANGELOG ship in the same PR. No AI attribution anywhere.

# What I need from you

1. **Commit-slice breakdown** — ordered, bisectable slices (each lint-green, each with its tests/docs where applicable). Consider dependency order carefully: e.g. UI can't lose the guest button before the join page stops needing ensureSignedIn? (Actually all lands on one branch/PR — order for reviewability + bisectability, not production safety.) Aim for ~5-8 focused commits.
2. **Per-slice file-level change list** with the key design calls made (GameShell browsingLocal state design; WorldSelect signedIn prop; join-page AccountPanel reuse; playOnline sign-in check; auth.test.ts replacement shape; migration 0003 mechanics incl. drizzle meta).
3. **Risks/gotchas list** — e.g. better-auth schema expectations after dropping the column (does the drizzleAdapter mind?); `Client` type after removing the plugin generic; e2e timing flakiness in signup forms; `onlineUsed()` semantics still needed anywhere (offline-first gate for currentUser probes — keep!); anything about `markOnlineUsed` now that ensureSignedIn dies (who marks online-used? AccountPanel sign-in? check `lib/auth/client.ts:39-47` callers).
4. **Verification section** — end-to-end manual pass script + automated gate.

Read any files you need. Return the complete plan as your final message (it will be merged into the plan file).

# Identity rework Phase 3 — retire the anonymous-guest layer

## Context

Phases 1–2 of the "Local Players vs Accounts" identity rework landed via PR #46 (merged to `main`). The new model: **Local Player** (logged out) = local profiles + local worlds, zero server calls; **Account** (logged in) = up to 5 server-side profiles, each owning up to 10 online worlds. Phase 2 was deliberately additive — the anonymous-guest layer (better-auth `anonymous()` plugin, "Play online as guest", guest invite-joins) still works.

Phase 3 finishes the reversal of the old "guests first" design: **online play requires an account**. Remove the anonymous auth layer, drop guest UI paths, rewire invite links to require sign-in + profile pick, clean up guest-owned server data, rewrite the guest e2e as a real-account e2e, and update all docs.

Original approved plan: `/Users/hutusi/.claude/plans/multiplayer-is-already-working-zazzy-alpaca.md` (Phase 3 section).

## Open decisions (settle before implementation)

1. **Existing guest-owned online worlds on the live deployment** — drop with release-note warning (default) vs one-time upgrade prompt.
2. **Save-slice keying** — keep `ticket.sub = account id` (roster/kick at account level) vs re-key per-profile (touches game server + save format).

## Scope (from approved plan §Phase 3, to be refined by exploration)

1. Remove anonymous auth: `anonymous()` plugin + `onLinkAccount` (`lib/auth/server.ts`), `anonymousClient()` + `ensureSignedIn` anonymous path (`lib/auth/client.ts`), `isAnonymous` column (`db/schema.ts`, `db/ddl.ts`), guest branches in `AccountPanel.tsx`.
2. Gate online to accounts server-side (reject anonymous / require account in `createWorld`, `createInvite`, `mintTicket` — verify what already landed in Phase 2).
3. Invites require sign-in: `app/join/[token]/page.tsx` — preview world name (no-auth GET), sign in / register, accept invite, pick profile, join.
4. Data migration: handle existing guest-owned worlds/memberships per decision (1).
5. Tests: remove/replace `lib/auth/auth.test.ts` onLinkAccount test; rewrite `e2e/multiplayer.e2e.ts` guest path → real account (fills missing account-play e2e coverage).
6. Docs: rewrite `docs/online.md` identity section; update `docs/protocol.md`, `docs/save-format.md`, `docs/testing.md`, `docs/manual.md`/`docs/reference.md` as needed; `CHANGELOG.md`.

## Branch & PR

New branch `feat/retire-guest-online` (name TBD) off updated `main`; own PR against `hutusi/monecraft` `main`. Focused conventional commits per slice; no AI attribution. Push/PR only when the user asks.

---

## Confirmed facts (exploration pass 1 — auth layer)

- **Only server gate landed in Phase 2**: `worldsService.ts:86` (`createProfile` rejects `owner.isAnonymous`). `createWorld` (:170), `createInvite` (:282), `mintTicket` (:347) are still guest-reachable — Phase 3 must add the account gate (or it becomes moot once anonymous sign-in is impossible; decide belt-and-braces vs rely on plugin removal).
- **Anonymous plugin**: `lib/auth/server.ts:3,41-68` (`anonymous({ onLinkAccount })` — re-parents worlds/invites/members guest→account). Only plugin in the list.
- **Client**: `lib/auth/client.ts:4,15,22` (anonymousClient), `:31,53-54` (`OnlineUser.isAnonymous`), `:57-65` (`ensureSignedIn` → `signIn.anonymous()`, the only such call site).
- **`ensureSignedIn` callers**: `app/join/[token]/page.tsx:26`, `components/GameShell.tsx:172` (playOnline), `components/menu/AccountPanel.tsx:145` ("Play online as guest" handler), + test mock in `AccountPanel.test.tsx`.
- **`isAnonymous` refs**: `db/schema.ts:31-32`, `db/ddl.ts:16`, migration `0000` (:37), `0001` backfill (`IS NOT TRUE`), `lib/online/http.ts:10,16-17`, `worldsService.ts:83,86`, `app/api/profiles/route.ts:19`, `GameShell.tsx:317` (account-mode flip), `AccountPanel.tsx:99,116-127,155`, tests (`auth.test.ts`, `worldsService.test.ts:167,183-187`, `AccountPanel.test.tsx`, `AccountProfileSelect.test.tsx:40`).
- **Migrations**: manual `bun run db:migrate` (drizzle-kit); PGlite paths use `db/ddl.ts` SCHEMA_DDL instead — every schema change mirrors in `db/schema.ts` + `db/ddl.ts` + new migration `0003`. Guest-owned worlds always have `profile_id = NULL` (0001 backfill skipped guests).
- **Cascade cleanup**: `DELETE FROM "user" WHERE is_anonymous IS TRUE` cascades sessions/accounts/worlds (→ their members+invites)/memberships/invites. Column nullable: real accounts have NULL.
- **`lib/auth/auth.test.ts`**: entire file tests guest→account upgrade (onLinkAccount) — delete/rewrite wholesale.
- **Game server / tickets / protocol: zero changes** — `signTicket({ sub, wid, name, skinId, role, pv })` never carried anonymity.
- **e2e**: `e2e/multiplayer.e2e.ts` AND `e2e/cloudSaves.e2e.ts` both drive "Play online as guest" — both need the account rewrite, not just multiplayer.
- **Docs w/ guest refs**: `docs/online.md` (":25-48 Identity: guests first", :12 diagram, :87 join page, :136 local-dev two-guests note), `docs/tuning.md:499`, `CHANGELOG.md:13,26`, comments in `app/api/auth/[...all]/route.ts:5`, `AccountProfileSelect.tsx:18`, `ProfileSelect.tsx:13`, `GameShell.tsx:35-36,163,260`. (`lib/game/engine/state.ts:39` "Survival guests" is unrelated — leave.)

## Confirmed facts (exploration pass 2 — invite/join UI)

- **`app/join/[token]/page.tsx`** (57 lines, sole file under app/join/): resolve preview (no-auth GET) → `ensureSignedIn()` (:26, silent guest mint) → `acceptInviteToken` → "joined" + `<Link href="/">`. **No shell handoff** — no params/pending-join; success = the membership row exists. "Deliberately unmagical" per header comment.
- **`POST /api/invite/[token]`** requires `sessionUser` (401), calls `acceptInvite(db, user.id, token)` — **memberships are account-level; `world_members` has no profileId** (`worldsService.ts:336`). So "pick which profile joins" only affects the play ticket (name/skin), not the membership.
- **CRITICAL GAP**: `OnlineWorldSelect.tsx:49-51` filters `kind === "mp" && world.profileId === profile.id` — an invite-joined world (owner's profileId) is **invisible in account mode**; today it only surfaces in legacy `WorldSelect`'s "Online Worlds" (shows all mp worlds w/ "Joined" label, WorldSelect.tsx:155,282,270-330). Phase 3 removes that legacy section ⇒ must add joined (non-owned) worlds to the account-mode list.
- **`AccountPanel.tsx`**: logged-out branch = "Play online as guest" (:138-156) + "Sign in" (:157). Guest branch (:117-127) = "Keep my worlds — create account" + "Sign out". Signup label switches on `user?.isAnonymous` (:99). `onAuthChange` fires after every auth mutation (:33-36).
- **`GameShell.tsx`**: `playOnline(profile, world, onlineProfile)` (:163-190) calls `ensureSignedIn()` (:172) then `requestJoinTicket(world.id, onlineProfile?.id)`; reconnect re-mints with same profileId (:177-182). Guest path call site `world-select`:292 (`onlineProfile=null`); account path `online-worlds`:307 via `profileFromOnline` (:40-42). `play-online.onlineProfile: null` marks the guest path; quit routes on it (:259-264).
- **`AccountProfileSelect`** = full MenuScreen w/ CRUD chrome (not a bare picker); fetches own data; `CreateProfileForm` → `onPlay(profile)` directly.
- **e2e reality**: no auth helpers/fixtures exist; everything drives the real UI against pglite/memory webServer (`playwright.config.ts:27-56`). `multiplayer.e2e.ts` = host "Play online as guest" + legacy WorldSelect create; friend context hits `/join/:token` (silent guest mint) then legacy list. Invite minted via `page.evaluate` fetch (clipboard unreachable headless). `cloudSaves.e2e.ts:48-50` also clicks "Play online as guest".
- **Component tests to rewrite**: `AccountPanel.test.tsx` tests 1-2 (guest flows, `signInAnonymousCalls` fake). `OnlineWorldSelect.test.tsx` gains joined-world coverage.
- `onlineClient.ts` helpers already sufficient: `resolveInviteToken`, `acceptInviteToken`, `requestJoinTicket(worldId, profileId?)`, `createInviteLink`.

*(Draft — awaiting exploration pass 3: docs inventory, save-slice keying, guest-data cleanup facts.)*

# Phase 3 Plan: Retire the anonymous-guest layer (accounts-only online)

Branch: `feat/account-only-online` off `main`, one PR. Eight slices, each `bun run format` + `bun run lint` green; e2e specs go red at slice 5 and green again at slice 7 (acceptable mid-branch; only lint gates per commit).

---

## Key design calls (made once, referenced by the slices)

**D1 — GameShell "Play locally" door: a `browsingLocal` boolean, not a new screen variant.**
The root render at `components/GameShell.tsx:317` is already a fall-through (not a `screen.name` branch), so the door is a sibling piece of state, not a screen:

- `const [browsingLocal, setBrowsingLocal] = useState(false)`.
- Root render becomes: `if (onlineUser && !browsingLocal) return <AccountProfileSelect … onPlayLocally={() => setBrowsingLocal(true)} />`, else `<ProfileSelect … onBackToAccount={onlineUser ? () => setBrowsingLocal(false) : undefined} />`.
- **Set** `browsingLocal = true` in two places: the Play-locally callback, and the session-resume path (`GameShell.tsx:196-198`) when a local-world pointer resumes — so a signed-in player who reloads mid-local-game and quits walks back out through the *local* menus (world-select → profile-select → "Back to account"), not an abrupt jump to account home.
- **Clear** it whenever `currentUser()` resolves null in `refreshOnlineUser` (`void currentUser().then((u) => { setOnlineUser(u); if (!u) setBrowsingLocal(false); })`) and via "Back to account". Sign-out from inside ProfileSelect's AccountPanel fires `onAuthChange` → this same path, so the stale flag can't survive a sign-out.
- ProfileSelect showing "Signed in as X / Sign out" while browsing locally is **desired**: it's the honest state ("you're signed in, browsing local worlds") and it gives cloud-save context. The way back is a new optional `onBackToAccount?: () => void` prop on `ProfileSelect`, rendered as a "Back to account" `mc-button` (`data-testid="back-to-account"`) directly under the `<AccountPanel/>` in **both** branches — the list view (`ProfileSelect.tsx:51`) **and the firstRun branch (`:36`)**, otherwise a signed-in account with zero local profiles that clicks Play locally is trapped on the create form.

**D2 — `playOnline` sign-in check: drop the pre-check entirely; sharpen the ticket-failure message.**
`playOnline` is only reachable from `OnlineWorldSelect` (account mode), so the user is signed in in every normal flow; the only failure left is an expired session, and `requestJoinTicket` already returns null on 401 which lands in the existing `connectError` alertdialog. Adding a `currentUser()` pre-check would cost a session roundtrip on *every* join to improve one rare message. So: delete line 172, change the message at `:174` to `"could not get a join ticket — are you still signed in, and is the game server configured?"`. `onlineProfile` becomes required (`OnlineProfile`, no null); `Screen` variant `play-online.onlineProfile: OnlineProfile`; quit routing (`:262-264`) collapses to always `{ name: "online-worlds", profile: screen.onlineProfile }`.

**D3 — WorldSelect cloud gating: a `cloudEnabled: boolean` prop.**
GameShell passes `cloudEnabled={onlineUser !== null}`. Inside WorldSelect: the `listOnlineWorlds` fetch (`:68-71`) runs only when `cloudEnabled`; the per-card gate at `:221` swaps `onlineUsed()` → `cloudEnabled`; server list filtered to `kind === "sp-cloud"` only (the `mpWorlds` split at `:154-157` dies). `onlineUsed` import removed from this file. Named `cloudEnabled` (not `signedIn`) because it gates exactly the cloud-saves UI, and GameShell stays the one place that decides what enables it.

**D4 — Join page: 4-phase state machine, reusing `<AccountPanel/>` as-is.**
`{ phase: "loading" } | { phase: "signin"; worldName: string } | { phase: "joined"; worldName: string } | { phase: "error"; message: string }`. Flow: `markOnlineUsed()` first (an invite click IS an online action, and without it GameShell's offline-first `refreshOnlineUser` gate would never probe the session after "Open the game" — this replaces the marking `ensureSignedIn` used to do) → `resolveInviteToken` (null → error) → `currentUser()` → if user, `acceptInviteToken` (false → "used up" error; already-member is idempotent-true) → joined; if no user, phase `signin`: render the world-name preview ("You're invited to **{worldName}** — sign in to join") + `<AccountPanel onAuthChange={() => setAuthNonce(n => n + 1)} />`, with `authNonce` in the effect deps so a successful sign-in/up re-runs resolve→accept. AccountPanel needs no MenuScreen: its classes (`account-panel`, `menu-form`, `menu-field`, `menu-input`, `mc-button`, `account-error`) are global app CSS; render it inside the existing `.net-modal-box`, and do one visual check in the manual pass. Keep the client component, the `cancelled` cleanup, and the "Open the game" link.

**D5 — `auth.test.ts` replacement: keep a lean better-auth-on-PGlite integration test, don't fold it away.**
It's the only test constructing `createAuth` + `drizzleAdapter` against the real schema — exactly the seam that would break if better-auth minded the dropped column or the plugin removal changed session shape. Replace the guest-upgrade suite with ~2 tests: (1) `signUpEmail` creates a user + session cookie; `getSession` returns id/name/email and the `skinId` additional field; (2) `signInEmail` with a wrong password fails, right password yields a session. Keep the `returnHeaders` cookie technique and `closeTestDb` in `afterAll` (exit-99 leak).

**D6 — Migration 0003 mechanics.**
1. Edit `db/schema.ts` (drop `:31-32`) and `db/ddl.ts` (drop `:16`) — these MUST move together (PGlite mirror).
2. `bunx drizzle-kit generate --name retire-anonymous-guests` → emits `db/migrations/0003_retire-anonymous-guests.sql` (`ALTER TABLE "user" DROP COLUMN "is_anonymous";`), `meta/0003_snapshot.json`, and the `_journal.json` entry (idx 3).
3. Hand-prepend to the SQL, following 0001's hand-edit precedent, with a comment block:
   `DELETE FROM "user" WHERE "is_anonymous" IS TRUE;--> statement-breakpoint` before the DROP. FKs cascade worlds/saveBlobs/memberships/invites.
4. PGlite paths need nothing more (fresh DDL each boot). Release note: deploy the new app **first**, then `bun run db:migrate` (old builds SELECT the column via the drizzle schema and would error post-drop; the new build never references it, and the still-present column is harmlessly ignored before migration).

**D7 — OnlineWorldSelect joined worlds.**
Filter (`:49-51`) becomes `world.kind === "mp" && (world.profileId === profile.id || world.role === "member")`, with a comment: *joined worlds appear under every profile — membership is account-level, and their `profileId` is the host's*. The "Joined" label already renders (`:91`) and owner actions are already gated (`:97`). **Cap fix**: `atCap` (`:54`) must count only `worlds.filter(w => w.profileId === profile.id)` or joined worlds visually eat your create quota (the server counts only owned).

---

## Commit slices

### Slice 1 — `feat(menu): list joined worlds in the account online-worlds screen`
Independently valuable; closes the joined-worlds gap while the legacy list still exists (brief double-visibility is fine).
- `components/menu/OnlineWorldSelect.tsx` — D7 filter + cap fix + comment; header doc `:14-18` ("Lists only this profile's…" → owned-or-joined).
- `components/menu/OnlineWorldSelect.test.tsx` — add: a member-role world (host's `profileId`) is visible with "Joined" and renders no Copy invite/Revoke buttons; cap test still counts owned only (seed `MAX_WORLDS_PER_PROFILE` owned + 1 joined, button disabled state per owned count).

### Slice 2 — `feat(menu): "Play locally" door between account home and the local menus`
- `components/menu/AccountProfileSelect.tsx` — new required prop `onPlayLocally: () => void`; button `data-testid="play-locally"`, label "Play locally", placed in a `menu-bottom-row` with the existing "New Profile" primary (mirrors WorldSelect's bottom row); header doc `:14-19` updated (drop "guests can't have profiles").
- `components/menu/ProfileSelect.tsx` — optional `onBackToAccount` prop + button in both branches (D1); doc comment `:13` sweep.
- `components/GameShell.tsx` — `browsingLocal` state, wiring, resume-path set, refresh-path clear (D1).
- `components/menu/AccountProfileSelect.test.tsx` — Play-locally callback test; `components/menu/ProfileSelect.test.tsx` — back-to-account renders only when prop given + fires.

### Slice 3 — `feat(join): invite landing requires an account — preview, inline sign-in, accept`
- `app/join/[token]/page.tsx` — full rewrite per D4 (drops one of the three `ensureSignedIn` callers; the AccountPanel it embeds still shows the guest button until slice 5 — note this in the commit body as a known mid-branch state).

### Slice 4 — `feat(menu): retire the local-menu Online Worlds section; cloud saves gate on the account`
- `components/menu/WorldSelect.tsx` — remove the Online Worlds section (`:270-330`), `onPlayOnline` prop (`:44-45`), `creatingOnline` mode (`:91-114`), invite state (`:57-59`), `createInviteLink/revokeInviteLinks` imports and `createOnlineWorld`'s mp usage; keep Upload-to-cloud (`:127-151`, `:221-235`) and Cloud Saves (`:255-269`) + `onDownloadCloud`; add `cloudEnabled` per D3.

The big one; everything here is compile-coupled through `OnlineUser.isAnonymous` and `ensureSignedIn`.
- `lib/auth/client.ts` — drop `anonymousClient` import/plugin; `type Client = ReturnType<typeof createAuthClient>`; `OnlineUser` loses `isAnonymous`; `currentUser` mapping simplified; **delete `ensureSignedIn`** (its two remaining callers go in this slice); rewrite module doc `:6-14` (keep the lazy-construction and offline-first rationale — `onlineUsed`/`markOnlineUsed` **stay**, they're the offline-first gate, unrelated to guests).

# Phase 3 Plan: Retire the anonymous-guest layer (accounts-only online)

Branch: `feat/account-only-online` off `main`, one PR. Eight slices, each `bun run format` + `bun run lint` green; e2e specs go red at slice 5 and green again at slice 7 (acceptable mid-branch; only lint gates per commit).

---

## Key design calls (made once, referenced by the slices)

**D1 — GameShell "Play locally" door: a `browsingLocal` boolean, not a new screen variant.**
The root render at `components/GameShell.tsx:317` is already a fall-through (not a `screen.name` branch), so the door is a sibling piece of state, not a screen:

- `const [browsingLocal, setBrowsingLocal] = useState(false)`.
- Root render becomes: `if (onlineUser && !browsingLocal) return <AccountProfileSelect … onPlayLocally={() => setBrowsingLocal(true)} />`, else `<ProfileSelect … onBackToAccount={onlineUser ? () => setBrowsingLocal(false) : undefined} />`.
- **Set** `browsingLocal = true` in two places: the Play-locally callback, and the session-resume path (`GameShell.tsx:196-198`) when a local-world pointer resumes — so a signed-in player who reloads mid-local-game and quits walks back out through the *local* menus (world-select → profile-select → "Back to account"), not an abrupt jump to account home.
- **Clear** it whenever `currentUser()` resolves null in `refreshOnlineUser` (`void currentUser().then((u) => { setOnlineUser(u); if (!u) setBrowsingLocal(false); })`) and via "Back to account". Sign-out from inside ProfileSelect's AccountPanel fires `onAuthChange` → this same path, so the stale flag can't survive a sign-out.
- ProfileSelect showing "Signed in as X / Sign out" while browsing locally is **desired**: it's the honest state ("you're signed in, browsing local worlds") and it gives cloud-save context. The way back is a new optional `onBackToAccount?: () => void` prop on `ProfileSelect`, rendered as a "Back to account" `mc-button` (`data-testid="back-to-account"`) directly under the `<AccountPanel/>` in **both** branches — the list view (`ProfileSelect.tsx:51`) **and the firstRun branch (`:36`)**, otherwise a signed-in account with zero local profiles that clicks Play locally is trapped on the create form.

**D2 — `playOnline` sign-in check: drop the pre-check entirely; sharpen the ticket-failure message.**
`playOnline` is only reachable from `OnlineWorldSelect` (account mode), so the user is signed in in every normal flow; the only failure left is an expired session, and `requestJoinTicket` already returns null on 401 which lands in the existing `connectError` alertdialog. Adding a `currentUser()` pre-check would cost a session roundtrip on *every* join to improve one rare message. So: delete line 172, change the message at `:174` to `"could not get a join ticket — are you still signed in, and is the game server configured?"`. `onlineProfile` becomes required (`OnlineProfile`, no null); `Screen` variant `play-online.onlineProfile: OnlineProfile`; quit routing (`:262-264`) collapses to always `{ name: "online-worlds", profile: screen.onlineProfile }`.

**D3 — WorldSelect cloud gating: a `cloudEnabled: boolean` prop.**
GameShell passes `cloudEnabled={onlineUser !== null}`. Inside WorldSelect: the `listOnlineWorlds` fetch (`:68-71`) runs only when `cloudEnabled`; the per-card gate at `:221` swaps `onlineUsed()` → `cloudEnabled`; server list filtered to `kind === "sp-cloud"` only (the `mpWorlds` split at `:154-157` dies). `onlineUsed` import removed from this file. Named `cloudEnabled` (not `signedIn`) because it gates exactly the cloud-saves UI, and GameShell stays the one place that decides what enables it.

**D4 — Join page: 4-phase state machine, reusing `<AccountPanel/>` as-is.**
`{ phase: "loading" } | { phase: "signin"; worldName: string } | { phase: "joined"; worldName: string } | { phase: "error"; message: string }`. Flow: `markOnlineUsed()` first (an invite click IS an online action, and without it GameShell's offline-first `refreshOnlineUser` gate would never probe the session after "Open the game" — this replaces the marking `ensureSignedIn` used to do) → `resolveInviteToken` (null → error) → `currentUser()` → if user, `acceptInviteToken` (false → "used up" error; already-member is idempotent-true) → joined; if no user, phase `signin`: render the world-name preview ("You're invited to **{worldName}** — sign in to join") + `<AccountPanel onAuthChange={() => setAuthNonce(n => n + 1)} />`, with `authNonce` in the effect deps so a successful sign-in/up re-runs resolve→accept. AccountPanel needs no MenuScreen: its classes (`account-panel`, `menu-form`, `menu-field`, `menu-input`, `mc-button`, `account-error`) are global app CSS; render it inside the existing `.net-modal-box`, and do one visual check in the manual pass. Keep the client component, the `cancelled` cleanup, and the "Open the game" link.

**D5 — `auth.test.ts` replacement: keep a lean better-auth-on-PGlite integration test, don't fold it away.**
It's the only test constructing `createAuth` + `drizzleAdapter` against the real schema — exactly the seam that would break if better-auth minded the dropped column or the plugin removal changed session shape. Replace the guest-upgrade suite with ~2 tests: (1) `signUpEmail` creates a user + session cookie; `getSession` returns id/name/email and the `skinId` additional field; (2) `signInEmail` with a wrong password fails, right password yields a session. Keep the `returnHeaders` cookie technique and `closeTestDb` in `afterAll` (exit-99 leak).

**D6 — Migration 0003 mechanics.**
1. Edit `db/schema.ts` (drop `:31-32`) and `db/ddl.ts` (drop `:16`) — these MUST move together (PGlite mirror).
2. `bunx drizzle-kit generate --name retire-anonymous-guests` → emits `db/migrations/0003_retire-anonymous-guests.sql` (`ALTER TABLE "user" DROP COLUMN "is_anonymous";`), `meta/0003_snapshot.json`, and the `_journal.json` entry (idx 3).
3. Hand-prepend to the SQL, following 0001's hand-edit precedent, with a comment block:
   `DELETE FROM "user" WHERE "is_anonymous" IS TRUE;--> statement-breakpoint` before the DROP. FKs cascade worlds/saveBlobs/memberships/invites.
4. PGlite paths need nothing more (fresh DDL each boot). Release note: deploy the new app **first**, then `bun run db:migrate` (old builds SELECT the column via the drizzle schema and would error post-drop; the new build never references it, and the still-present column is harmlessly ignored before migration).

**D7 — OnlineWorldSelect joined worlds.**
Filter (`:49-51`) becomes `world.kind === "mp" && (world.profileId === profile.id || world.role === "member")`, with a comment: *joined worlds appear under every profile — membership is account-level, and their `profileId` is the host's*. The "Joined" label already renders (`:91`) and owner actions are already gated (`:97`). **Cap fix**: `atCap` (`:54`) must count only `worlds.filter(w => w.profileId === profile.id)` or joined worlds visually eat your create quota (the server counts only owned).

# Identity rework Phase 3 — retire the anonymous-guest layer (accounts-only online)

## Context

Phases 1–2 of the "Local Players vs Accounts" identity rework landed via PR #46 (merged). The model: **Local Player** (logged out) = local profiles/worlds, zero server calls; **Account** (logged in) = up to 5 server profiles (`MAX_ONLINE_PROFILES`), each owning up to 10 online worlds (`MAX_WORLDS_PER_PROFILE`). Phase 2 was deliberately additive — the anonymous-guest layer (better-auth `anonymous()` plugin, "Play online as guest", silent guest-minting on invite links) still works.

Phase 3 completes the reversal of the old "guests first" design (`docs/online.md`): **online play requires an account**. It also fixes two gaps Phase 2 left: signed-in accounts lost access to the cloud-saves UI (it lives in the local `WorldSelect`, which account mode never shows), and invite-joined worlds are invisible in account mode (`OnlineWorldSelect` filters by owner `profileId`; memberships are account-level).

Original approved plan: `/Users/hutusi/.claude/plans/multiplayer-is-already-working-zazzy-alpaca.md` (§Phase 3).

## Decisions (settled with the user, 2026-07-04)

1. **Cloud saves — "Play locally" door.** Account home gains a "Play locally" button into the local menus while staying signed in; cloud-save upload/download stays in `WorldSelect`, gated on a signed-in account.
2. **Guest data — delete via migration 0003.** `DELETE FROM "user" WHERE is_anonymous IS TRUE` (FKs cascade worlds/saveBlobs/memberships/invites), then drop the column. Release-note it.
3. **Save-slice keying — keep account `sub`.** Zero changes to `lib/net/tickets.ts`, `server/`, protocol, save format. Per-profile keying deferred.
4. **Invite flow — unmagical + fix the list.** `/join/[token]`: preview → inline sign-in/register → accept → "Open the game". No profile pick on the page; fix `OnlineWorldSelect` to also list member-role (joined) mp worlds.

## Branch & PR

Branch `feat/account-only-online` off `main`; own PR against `hutusi/monecraft` `main`. Conventional commits, why-focused bodies, no attribution lines. Per-commit local verify = `bun run format` + `bun run lint` only; full gate once before the PR. Push/PR only when the user asks.

---

## Key design calls

**D1 — "Play locally" door = a `browsingLocal` boolean in GameShell**, not a screen variant (the account flip at `GameShell.tsx:317` is the fall-through render, not a `screen.name` branch).
- Set: `AccountProfileSelect.onPlayLocally`, and the session-resume path (`GameShell.tsx:196-198`) when a local-world pointer resumes (so quit walks back out through local menus, not an abrupt jump to account home).
- Clear: "Back to account", and whenever `currentUser()` resolves null in `refreshOnlineUser` (sign-out from ProfileSelect's AccountPanel fires `onAuthChange` → same path, so a stale flag can't survive sign-out).
- `ProfileSelect` gets optional `onBackToAccount?: () => void` → "Back to account" button (`data-testid="back-to-account"`) under `<AccountPanel/>` in **both** branches — list view AND firstRun (else a signed-in account with zero local profiles is trapped on the create form). AccountPanel showing "Signed in as X" while browsing locally is desired (honest state, explains the cloud buttons).

**D2 — `playOnline` drops the `ensureSignedIn()` pre-check** (`GameShell.tsx:172`) with no replacement: it's only reachable from account mode; an expired session makes `requestJoinTicket` return null, landing in the existing `connectError` alertdialog. **D3 — `WorldSelect` gets a `cloudEnabled: boolean` prop** (GameShell passes `onlineUser !== null`): gates the `listOnlineWorlds` fetch (`:68-71`) and the per-card Upload-to-cloud gate (`:221`, replacing `onlineUsed()`); server list filtered to `kind === "sp-cloud"` only.

**D4 — Join page = 4-phase state machine reusing `<AccountPanel/>` as-is**: `loading | signin (worldName) | joined (worldName) | error (message)`. Flow: `markOnlineUsed()` first (**load-bearing** — replaces the marking `ensureSignedIn` did; without it GameShell's offline-first gate never probes the session after "Open the game") → `resolveInviteToken` → `currentUser()` → signed in ? accept → joined : render preview ("You're invited to **{worldName}** — sign in to join") + `<AccountPanel onAuthChange={bump authNonce}/>`; `authNonce` in the effect deps re-runs resolve→accept after sign-in. AccountPanel's classes are global CSS — renders fine inside the existing `.net-modal-box`; one visual check in the manual pass. Keep the accept in the nonce-driven effect, not inside `onAuthChange` (panel unmounts on phase flip).

**D5 — `lib/auth/auth.test.ts` replaced, not deleted**: it's the only test constructing `createAuth` + drizzleAdapter against the real schema (the tripwire if better-auth ever minds the dropped column). ~2 tests: signUpEmail → user + session cookie + `skinId` additional field via getSession; signInEmail wrong/right password. Keep the `returnHeaders` cookie technique + `closeTestDb` in `afterAll`.

**D6 — Migration 0003 mechanics**: edit `db/schema.ts:31-32` + `db/ddl.ts:16` together (PGlite mirror); `bunx drizzle-kit generate --name retire-anonymous-guests` (emits the DROP COLUMN sql + `meta/0003_snapshot.json` + `_journal.json` entry); hand-prepend `DELETE FROM "user" WHERE "is_anonymous" IS TRUE;--> statement-breakpoint` with a comment block (0001's hand-edit precedent). **Deploy order: new app first, then `bun run db:migrate`** — old builds SELECT the column via drizzle and would error post-drop; the new build ignores the still-present column.

**D7 — `OnlineWorldSelect` joined worlds**: filter (`:49-51`) → `kind === "mp" && (world.profileId === profile.id || world.role === "member")` + comment (joined worlds appear under every profile — membership is account-level; their `profileId` is the host's). "Joined" label (`:91`) and owner-gated actions (`:97`) already exist. **Cap fix**: `atCap` (`:54`) must count only owned (`profileId === profile.id`) worlds — the server caps only owned.

- Clear: "Back to account", and whenever `currentUser()` resolves null in `refreshOnlineUser` (sign-out from ProfileSelect's AccountPanel fires `onAuthChange` → same path, so a stale flag can't survive sign-out).

**D2 — `playOnline` drops the `ensureSignedIn()` pre-check** (`GameShell.tsx:172`) with no replacement: it's only reachable from account mode; an expired session makes `requestJoinTicket` return null, landing in the existing `connectError` alertdialog. **D4 — Join page = 4-phase state machine reusing `<AccountPanel/>` as-is**: `loading | signin (worldName) | joined (worldName) | error (message)`. Flow: `markOnlineUsed()` first (**load-bearing** — replaces the marking `ensureSignedIn` did; without it GameShell's offline-first gate never probes the session after "Open the game") → `resolveInviteToken` → `currentUser()` → signed in ? accept → joined : render preview ("You're invited to **{worldName}** — sign in to join") + `<AccountPanel onAuthChange={bump authNonce}/>`; `authNonce` in the effect deps re-runs resolve→accept after sign-in. ## Risks / gotchas

1. **Deploy order vs 0003** (D6) — new app first, migrate second; migration is deliberately destructive to guest data.
2. **better-auth after plugin removal** — adapter never touches the column once the plugin is gone; new `auth.test.ts` is the tripwire.
3. **`onlineUsed()` survives** — offline-first gate (`GameShell:104`, `AccountPanel:30`). With `ensureSignedIn` gone, `markOnlineUsed` setters = `AccountPanel.submit` + the join page; the join-page call is **load-bearing** (forget it → friend's "Open the game" lands on local menus while signed in).
4. **OnlineWorldSelect cap** — joined worlds must not eat the create quota (D7).
5. **e2e locators** — `exact: true` on the profile form's "Create"; distinct emails per context; sign-up → account home spans two hops, generous timeout on "Your Profiles".
6. **`bun test` exit 99** — passed-but-leaked PGlite is expected; never gate on `bun test | tail`; new PGlite tests must `closeTestDb`.
7. **Join-page accept lives in the nonce-driven effect**, not `onAuthChange` (panel unmounts on phase flip).
8. **Legacy mp rows with `profileId: null`**: owned ones stay hidden (pre-existing; 0001 backfilled real deployments); member-role ones now surface via the new filter arm — strictly an improvement.

# Identity rework Phase 3 — retire the anonymous-guest layer

## Context

Phases 1–2 of the "Local Players vs Accounts" identity rework landed via PR #46 (merged to `main`). The new model: **Local Player** (logged out) = local profiles + local worlds, zero server calls; **Account** (logged in) = up to 5 server-side profiles, each owning up to 10 online worlds. Phase 2 was deliberately additive — the anonymous-guest layer (better-auth `anonymous()` plugin, "Play online as guest", guest invite-joins) still works.

Phase 3 finishes the reversal of the old "guests first" design: **online play requires an account**. Remove the anonymous auth layer, drop guest UI paths, rewire invite links to require sign-in + profile pick, clean up guest-owned server data, rewrite the guest e2e as a real-account e2e, and update all docs.

Original approved plan: `/Users/hutusi/.claude/plans/multiplayer-is-already-working-zazzy-alpaca.md` (Phase 3 section).

1. **Cloud saves — "Play locally" door.** `AccountProfileSelect` gains a "Play locally" button dropping a signed-in user into the local `ProfileSelect`/`WorldSelect` while staying signed in; cloud-save upload/download stays in `WorldSelect`, gated on a real signed-in account. 2. **Guest data — delete via migration 0003.** `DELETE FROM "user" WHERE is_anonymous IS TRUE` (cascades worlds/blobs/memberships/invites) then drop the column. Release-note it.
3. **Save-slice keying — keep account `sub`.** Zero ticket/server/protocol/save changes; per-profile keying deferred as its own future project.
4. **Invite flow — unmagical + fix the list.** `/join/[token]`: preview → inline sign-in/register → accept → "Open the game". No profile pick on the page. Separately fix `OnlineWorldSelect` to also list member-role (joined) mp worlds with a "Joined" label — today joined worlds are invisible in account mode.

## Scope (from approved plan §Phase 3, to be refined by exploration)

1. Remove anonymous auth: `anonymous()` plugin + `onLinkAccount` (`lib/auth/server.ts`), `anonymousClient()` + `ensureSignedIn` anonymous path (`lib/auth/client.ts`), `isAnonymous` column (`db/schema.ts`, `db/ddl.ts`), guest branches in `AccountPanel.tsx`.

5. Tests: remove/replace `lib/auth/auth.test.ts` onLinkAccount test; rewrite `e2e/multiplayer.e2e.ts` guest path → real account (fills missing account-play e2e coverage).

# Identity rework Phase 3 — retire the anonymous-guest layer (accounts-only online)

## Context

Phases 1–2 of the "Local Players vs Accounts" identity rework landed via PR #46 (merged). The model: **Local Player** (logged out) = local profiles/worlds, zero server calls; **Account** (logged in) = up to 5 server profiles (`MAX_ONLINE_PROFILES`), each owning up to 10 online worlds (`MAX_WORLDS_PER_PROFILE`). Phase 2 was deliberately additive — the anonymous-guest layer (better-auth `anonymous()` plugin, "Play online as guest", silent guest-minting on invite links) still works.

Phase 3 completes the reversal of the old "guests first" design (`docs/online.md`): **online play requires an account**. It also fixes two gaps Phase 2 left: signed-in accounts lost access to the cloud-saves UI (it lives in the local `WorldSelect`, which account mode never shows), and invite-joined worlds are invisible in account mode (`OnlineWorldSelect` filters by owner `profileId`; memberships are account-level).

Original approved plan: `/Users/hutusi/.claude/plans/multiplayer-is-already-working-zazzy-alpaca.md` (§Phase 3).

## Decisions (settled with the user, 2026-07-04)

1. **Cloud saves — "Play locally" door.** Account home gains a "Play locally" button into the local menus while staying signed in; cloud-save upload/download stays in `WorldSelect`, gated on a signed-in account.
2. **Guest data — delete via migration 0003.** `DELETE FROM "user" WHERE is_anonymous IS TRUE` (FKs cascade worlds/saveBlobs/memberships/invites), then drop the column. Release-note it.
3. **Save-slice keying — keep account `sub`.** Zero changes to `lib/net/tickets.ts`, `server/`, protocol, save format. Per-profile keying deferred.
4. **Invite flow — unmagical + fix the list.** `/join/[token]`: preview → inline sign-in/register → accept → "Open the game". No profile pick on the page; fix `OnlineWorldSelect` to also list member-role (joined) mp worlds.

## Branch & PR

Branch `feat/account-only-online` off `main`; own PR against `hutusi/monecraft` `main`. Conventional commits, why-focused bodies, no attribution lines. Per-commit local verify = `bun run format` + `bun run lint` only; full gate once before the PR. Push/PR only when the user asks.

---

## Key design calls

**D1 — "Play locally" door = a `browsingLocal` boolean in GameShell**, not a screen variant (the account flip at `GameShell.tsx:317` is the fall-through render, not a `screen.name` branch).
- Set: `AccountProfileSelect.onPlayLocally`, and the session-resume path (`GameShell.tsx:196-198`) when a local-world pointer resumes (so quit walks back out through local menus, not an abrupt jump to account home).
- Clear: "Back to account", and whenever `currentUser()` resolves null in `refreshOnlineUser` (sign-out from ProfileSelect's AccountPanel fires `onAuthChange` → same path, so a stale flag can't survive sign-out).

**D2 — `playOnline` drops the `ensureSignedIn()` pre-check** (`GameShell.tsx:172`) with no replacement: it's only reachable from account mode; an expired session makes `requestJoinTicket` return null, landing in the existing `connectError` alertdialog. **D4 — Join page = 4-phase state machine reusing `<AccountPanel/>` as-is**: `loading | signin (worldName) | joined (worldName) | error (message)`. Keep the accept in the nonce-driven effect, not inside `onAuthChange` (panel unmounts on phase flip).

## Context

Phases 1–2 of the "Local Players vs Accounts" identity rework landed via PR #46 (merged). The model: **Local Player** (logged out) = local profiles/worlds, zero server calls; **Account** (logged in) = up to 5 server profiles (`MAX_ONLINE_PROFILES`), each owning up to 10 online worlds (`MAX_WORLDS_PER_PROFILE`). Phase 2 was deliberately additive — the anonymous-guest layer (better-auth `anonymous()` plugin, "Play online as guest", silent guest-minting on invite links) still works.

Phase 3 completes the reversal of the old "guests first" design (`docs/online.md`): **online play requires an account**. It also fixes two gaps Phase 2 left: signed-in accounts lost access to the cloud-saves UI (it lives in the local `WorldSelect`, which account mode never shows), and invite-joined worlds are invisible in account mode (`OnlineWorldSelect` filters by owner `profileId`; memberships are account-level).

Original approved plan: `/Users/hutusi/.claude/plans/multiplayer-is-already-working-zazzy-alpaca.md` (§Phase 3).

## Decisions (settled with the user, 2026-07-04)

1. **Cloud saves — "Play locally" door.** Account home gains a "Play locally" button into the local menus while staying signed in; cloud-save upload/download stays in `WorldSelect`, gated on a signed-in account.
2. **Guest data — delete via migration 0003.** `DELETE FROM "user" WHERE is_anonymous IS TRUE` (FKs cascade worlds/saveBlobs/memberships/invites), then drop the column. Release-note it.
3. **Save-slice keying — keep account `sub`.** Zero changes to `lib/net/tickets.ts`, `server/`, protocol, save format. Per-profile keying deferred.
4. **Invite flow — unmagical + fix the list.** `/join/[token]`: preview → inline sign-in/register → accept → "Open the game". No profile pick on the page; fix `OnlineWorldSelect` to also list member-role (joined) mp worlds.

## Branch & PR

Branch `feat/account-only-online` off `main`; own PR against `hutusi/monecraft` `main`. Conventional commits, why-focused bodies, no attribution lines. Per-commit local verify = `bun run format` + `bun run lint` only; full gate once before the PR. **After all commits + the full gate: push the branch and open the PR** (`gh pr create --repo hutusi/monecraft --base main`, no AI-attribution in the description) — user pre-authorized this session.

## Key design calls

**D1 — "Play locally" door = a `browsingLocal` boolean in GameShell**, not a screen variant (the account flip at `GameShell.tsx:317` is the fall-through render, not a `screen.name` branch).
- Set: `AccountProfileSelect.onPlayLocally`, and the session-resume path (`GameShell.tsx:196-198`) when a local-world pointer resumes (so quit walks back out through local menus, not an abrupt jump to account home).
- Clear: "Back to account", and whenever `currentUser()` resolves null in `refreshOnlineUser` (sign-out from ProfileSelect's AccountPanel fires `onAuthChange` → same path, so a stale flag can't survive sign-out).
- `ProfileSelect` gets optional `onBackToAccount?: () => void` → "Back to account" button (`data-testid="back-to-account"`) under `<AccountPanel/>` in **both** branches — list view AND firstRun (else a signed-in account with zero local profiles is trapped on the create form). AccountPanel showing "Signed in as X" while browsing locally is desired (honest state, explains the cloud buttons).

**D2 — `playOnline` drops the `ensureSignedIn()` pre-check** (`GameShell.tsx:172`) with no replacement: it's only reachable from account mode; an expired session makes `requestJoinTicket` return null, landing in the existing `connectError` alertdialog. Sharpen that message to "could not get a join ticket — are you still signed in, and is the game server configured?". `onlineProfile` param and the `play-online` screen field become required non-null; quit routing (`:262-264`) collapses to always `online-worlds`.

**D3 — `WorldSelect` gets a `cloudEnabled: boolean` prop** (GameShell passes `onlineUser !== null`): gates the `listOnlineWorlds` fetch (`:68-71`) and the per-card Upload-to-cloud gate (`:221`, replacing `onlineUsed()`); server list filtered to `kind === "sp-cloud"` only.

**D4 — Join page = 4-phase state machine reusing `<AccountPanel/>` as-is**: `loading | signin (worldName) | joined (worldName) | error (message)`. Flow: `markOnlineUsed()` first (**load-bearing** — replaces the marking `ensureSignedIn` did; without it GameShell's offline-first gate never probes the session after "Open the game") → `resolveInviteToken` → `currentUser()` → signed in ? accept → joined : render preview ("You're invited to **{worldName}** — sign in to join") + `<AccountPanel onAuthChange={bump authNonce}/>`; `authNonce` in the effect deps re-runs resolve→accept after sign-in. AccountPanel's classes are global CSS — renders fine inside the existing `.net-modal-box`; one visual check in the manual pass. Keep the accept in the nonce-driven effect, not inside `onAuthChange` (panel unmounts on phase flip).

**D5 — `lib/auth/auth.test.ts` replaced, not deleted**: it's the only test constructing `createAuth` + drizzleAdapter against the real schema (the tripwire if better-auth ever minds the dropped column). ~2 tests: signUpEmail → user + session cookie + `skinId` additional field via getSession; signInEmail wrong/right password. git commit -m "feat(auth)!: remove the anonymous guest layer — accounts required for online play

Completes the Local-Players-vs-Accounts identity model: online play now
needs an email/password account, and logged-out players are purely local
(zero server calls). The anonymous plugin, its onLinkAccount re-parenting
hook, ensureSignedIn's silent guest minting, the isAnonymous flag on
OnlineUser/SessionUser, and every guest branch in the menu go away in one
slice — they are compile-coupled through the shared types.

Consequences worth noting:
- createProfile takes a plain ownerId again: with anonymous sign-in gone,
  holding a session IS the account check, so the per-endpoint guest guard
  has nothing left to guard.
- playOnline drops its sign-in pre-check: it is only reachable from
  account mode, and an expired session simply fails the ticket mint into
  the existing connection-error dialog.
- The offline-first flag (markOnlineUsed) is now set only by the account
  panel's form and the invite landing page.
- lib/auth/auth.test.ts refocuses from the guest-upgrade flow to the seam
  that remains: real better-auth + drizzle on PGlite, email/password
  sign-up/sign-in, and the session shape (id/name/skinId) the routes read.
- Test-only hardening: every mock.module of a shared client module now
  mirrors the module's full export surface — bun cannot add names to an
  already-created module namespace, so a narrow mock in whichever file
  runs first used to poison later imports (WorldSelect's cloud tests now
  fake onlineClient instead of global fetch for the same reason).

The e2e specs still drive the removed guest buttons and go red here; they
are rewritten as real-account journeys in a following commit. The
is_anonymous column is dropped in the migration commit after that." && git log --oneline -1

content.content:
1	# Online: accounts, cloud saves, multiplayer
2	
3	How the online stack fits together, and how to run it. The offline
4	single-player game needs **none** of this: without an online action, the
5	client never makes an auth request (the `minecraft_online_v1` localStorage
6	flag gates even the session check).
7	
8	## The pieces
9	
10	```
11	Browser ──(cookies)── Next.js app          ── Neon/Postgres
12	   │                   /api/auth/*   better-auth (guests + accounts)
13	   │                   /api/worlds…  world CRUD, invites, cloud saves
14	   │                   /api/worlds/:id/ticket   mints 60s HS256 join ticket
15	   │
16	   └──(ws + ticket)── Game server (Bun, Fly.io)  ── same Postgres
17	                       one authoritative GameEngine room per world (phase 4)
18	```

## Online accounts

Server-side quotas that bound per-account storage on the shared database. Live
in `config.ts` and are enforced in `lib/online/worldsService.ts` (the UI only
surfaces a friendly "limit reached"); they don't affect single-player.

- **`MAX_ONLINE_PROFILES`** (`5`) — profiles one signed-in account may create.
  A profile is a cross-device identity (name + skin) that owns online worlds;
  guests (anonymous) can't create any. Raising it grows the profile list and the
  worlds an account can accumulate (`MAX_ONLINE_PROFILES × MAX_WORLDS_PER_PROFILE`).
- **`MAX_WORLDS_PER_PROFILE`** (`10`) — online worlds one profile may own. The
  11th create is refused server-side. Bounds save-blob storage per profile.

## Save- and worldgen-sensitive tunables

---
README.md:8:The twist: **everything is procedural — zero binary assets.** Block textures and item sprites are painted from pixel code, all sound and music is synthesized at runtime, and lighting is computed per voxel. Single-player is client-only: keep **multiple worlds** under **multiple player profiles**, all saved to localStorage, no account needed. Or play **online co-op** (2–8 players): host a server-backed world and share an invite link — friends join as one-click guests. See [docs/manual.md](docs/manual.md#playing-online).

(Arrow/vehicle replication stays on the unit tests — `server/room.test.ts` + `NetworkSession.test.ts` — as driving them end-to-end is too environment-fragile.)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |

contents of every chest — so the world regenerates identically and picks up where
you left off. Because saves
live in the browser, they're tied to that browser on that device; "Reset" starts a
fresh world.

## Playing online

Online worlds are shared worlds that live on a server and hold **2–8 players** —
private co-op with people you invite, not public matchmaking. Everything offline
stays exactly as it is: local worlds never need an account or a connection.

**Getting an identity.** The first online action signs you in as a **guest** —
one click, no form, from the **Account** panel on the profile screen (or
automatically when you accept an invite). Guests are real accounts: the worlds
you create and join are yours. When you want to keep them across browsers,
**Create account** upgrades the guest in place — your worlds come with you.

**Hosting.** On the world list, the **Online Worlds** section appears once
you've gone online. **New Online World** uses the same form as a local world
(name, seed, world type, mode, difficulty); creating it connects you straight
in. Press **Copy invite** on your world's card to put a join link on the
clipboard — send it to your friends. Invite links expire after a while; copy a
fresh one any time.

**Joining.** Opening an invite link shows the world's name, signs you in (as a
guest if you're new), and adds the world to your **Online Worlds** list — click
its card to play. The world is yours to rejoin from that list from then on;
the link is only needed once.

**Playing together.** Everyone shares one world: block edits, mobs, chests,
day and night. You'll see the other players in the world with their names
overhead, and a player list in the top-right corner. Press **`T`** (or
`Enter`) to chat; a ping badge shows your connection quality, and losing the
connection pops a notice with the option to leave. The **server** owns the
world — your mining completes when it confirms the break (a barely-noticeable
beat on a good connection), and your health, hunger, and inventory are its
word, not the client's.

A few things work differently online, and the rest is the same game:

- **Pause is personal.** `Esc` opens your menu but the world keeps running —
  nobody can stop a shared world. "Save & Quit" becomes **Leave world**.
- **Sleeping needs everyone.** The night skips only when **all** players are
  in bed (dead and Spectator players excepted) — climb back out to cancel.
- **Progress is your own.** Advancements, statistics, XP, and kill credit are
  per-player — you earn your own, whether the kill was a sword, an arrow, or
  your pet's doing. Your pet follows **you**, not the nearest player.
- **The world owner can kick.** If you created the world, the player list shows
  a **Kick** button beside everyone else (free your cursor with `Esc` to click
  it) — for removing a griefer on the spot. To stop them coming back, also
  **Revoke links** from the world's menu card.
- **Boats are shared.** Rafts and ships are boardable online — pile into one
  together.
- The world saves on the server automatically; there's nothing to manage.

### Cloud saves — your single-player worlds across devices

Signed in, you can make a **single-player** world follow you between browsers
and machines. On the world's card, **Upload to cloud** copies it to your
account (the card then reads **☁ Synced**), and from there every save syncs up
automatically as you play. On another device, your synced worlds appear under
**Cloud Saves** — **Download** brings one onto that device to play.

It's last-write-wins: if the same world is played on two devices, the most
recent save wins. Open a synced world and it always catches up to the latest
first; a world you played offline keeps its newer progress rather than being
overwritten by an older cloud copy. Local worlds you never upload stay entirely
offline, exactly as before — cloud saves are opt-in, one world at a time.

# Monecraft (Next.js + TypeScript + Three.js + Bun)

[![CI](https://github.com/hutusi/monecraft/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/hutusi/monecraft/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/tag/hutusi/monecraft?label=release&sort=semver)](https://github.com/hutusi/monecraft/tags)

A playable, Minecraft-inspired voxel game that runs entirely in your browser. Explore procedural terrain across five biomes, cross water by **raft** or **ship** — over living oceans with **fish**, **kelp**, sunken **shipwrecks** to dive, and **buried treasure** to hunt by map — and dig into **dark caves** — lit only by the torches you craft and place, where lava pools and mobs lurk. Mine ores, raid **underground dungeons** for loot, build and farm, breed animals, craft through seven gear tiers up to a **bow** and throwable **spears**, and take on an **endgame boss** for a true win condition — all across a day-night cycle with hunger, drowning, and lava hazards.

The twist: **everything is procedural — zero binary assets.** Block textures and item sprites are painted from pixel code, all sound and music is synthesized at runtime, and lighting is computed per voxel. Single-player is client-only: keep **multiple worlds** under **multiple player profiles**, all saved to localStorage, no account needed. Or play **online co-op** (2–8 players): host a server-backed world and share an invite link — friends join as one-click guests. See [docs/manual.md](docs/manual.md#playing-online).

## Run

content.content:
1	# Changelog
2	
3	All notable changes to this project are documented in this file.
4	
5	## [Unreleased]
6	
7	### Added
8	
9	- **Cloud saves — single-player worlds across devices**: signed in, you can now make a single-player world follow you between browsers and machines. An **Upload to cloud** action on a world's card copies it to your account (the card then reads **☁ Synced**) and syncs every autosave up from then on; on another device your synced worlds appear under a **Cloud Saves** section to **Download** and play. It's last-write-wins with a safe open-time reconcile: opening a synced world adopts the newer cloud copy only when it actually advanced past this device — so a world you played offline keeps its newer progress instead of being clobbered — and a losing write during play warns you and stops syncing rather than overwriting the other device. Opt-in per world; worlds you never upload stay fully offline, and this is a local-manifest link (`WorldMeta.cloudId`) — the world save format is unchanged. Wires up the cloud-save transport that shipped as groundwork in v0.13.0.
10	- **Online co-op — in-game player list & owner kick**: every online world now shows a **player list** in the top-right corner, and the world **owner** gets a **Kick** button beside each other player to eject a griefer without leaving the world (free the cursor with `Esc` to click it — the panel sits above the pause overlay). content.content:
> vars are inlined at build time — changing one needs a **redeploy**, not just an
> env edit.

## Verify the whole thing

1. `curl https://<fly-app>.fly.dev/health` → `{"ok":true,…}`.
2. Open the deployed web app. It should look and play exactly like single-player
   (offline-first: no account, no network until you go online).
3. Click **Play online as guest** (profile screen → Account panel). It should say
   "Playing as guest" — that proves Vercel ↔ Neon ↔ better-auth work.
4. Create a **New Online World**, then **Copy invite**. Open the link in a second
   browser (or a private window), accept, and play the world from its card. Both
   players seeing each other proves the join ticket + Fly game server work.

If step 3 fails, it's the web/DB side (auth or `DATABASE_URL`). If step 4 connects
as far as "Joining…" then errors, it's almost always the ticket secret or the
---
| Symptom                         | Cause                                                                              |
| ------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Join fails, close code **4000** | `GAME_TICKET_SECRET` differs between Vercel and Fly — the #1 issue.                |
| "could not get a join ticket"   | `NEXT_PUBLIC_GAME_SERVER_URL` unset, or the world isn't a `mp` world.              |
| Connects then instantly drops   | Wrong scheme — must be **`wss://`** (not `ws://`) against an https Fly app.        |
| 500s on any `/api/worlds*`      | `DATABASE_URL` wrong, or the migration wasn't applied (Step 1).                    |
| Guest sign-in hangs             | `BETTER_AUTH_URL` doesn't match the actual origin, or `BETTER_AUTH_SECRET` unset.  |
| Game server won't boot          | Missing `GAME_TICKET_SECRET` (it exits on start) or an unreachable `DATABASE_URL`. |

Admin diagnostics on the game server (all behind `Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN`):
`GET /rooms` (players, tick p95, bandwidth), `GET /rooms/:id/log` (replay dump).

content.content:
# Save format & compatibility

## Schema

`SaveData` (version 16) in `lib/game/types.ts`:

- world `seed`
- `worldType` (optional) — the generation preset (`"default"` | `"flat"` | `"amplified"` | `"islands"`); absent ⇒ `"default"`. Like `seed`, it is fixed for the world's life and the world must always regenerate with it, since the block-diffs were recorded against that terrain
- `gameMode` (optional) — the player's game mode (`"survival"` | `"creative"` | `"adventure"` | `"spectator"`); absent ⇒ `"survival"`. Unlike `worldType`, this is **switchable in-game** (pause menu), so the saved value is the _current_ mode, not the one chosen at creation. Restored by `restoreGameMode` (`lib/game/save.ts`); `isFlying` is session-only and never serialized
- `difficulty` (optional) — the player's difficulty (`"peaceful"` | `"easy"` | `"normal"` | `"hard"`); absent ⇒ `"normal"`. An axis orthogonal to `gameMode`, and likewise **switchable in-game** (pause menu), so the saved value is the _current_ difficulty. Restored by `restoreDifficulty` (`lib/game/save.ts`); the per-level multipliers live in `lib/game/difficulties.ts`, the starvation accumulator (`starvationTimer`) is session-only
- `hardcore` (optional) — the Hardcore flag (`boolean`); absent ⇒ `false`. **Immutable** (unlike `gameMode`/`difficulty`): a hardcore world is forced to Survival + Hard and the engine locks both switchers. Restored by `restoreHardcore`
- `gameOver` (optional) — the permadeath flag (`boolean`); absent ⇒ `false`. Set once a hardcore run has ended in death; a reloaded `gameOver` world boots into the spectator "dead world" state (never playable). Restored by `restoreGameOver`. (The transient `isDead`/`respawnTimer` stay session-only — hardcore death is captured by this flag instead.)
- a block **diff** list — `changes: [blockIndex, blockId][]`; edits that revert to the generated baseline are pruned (player-placed crops, beds, furnaces, chests, and both halves/states of doors ride this list — they are ordinary block edits)
- inventory slots with durability, **enchantments, and a custom name** (36 slots; the first 9 are the hotbar). The same path serializes chest contents
- `xp` (optional) — banked experience points (`XP_PER_LEVEL` points = one level). Earned from kills/ore/fishing, spent at the enchanting table. Restored by `restoreXp` (finite, ≥ 0). Unlike effects, XP is a currency and is **kept across death**
- equipped armor — the worn pieces themselves (one per slot, dedicated storage), persisted as per-slot `SavedSlot` via `serializeEquippedArmor`/`restoreEquippedArmor` (so worn durability/enchantments/customName survive). A worn piece lives **only** here, not in the 36 inventory slots
- selected hotbar slot (0–8)
- player position — validated on load by `restorePlayerPosition` (`lib/game/save.ts`): coords keep their fractional part (the player isn't grid-aligned) but a missing or non-finite (NaN/Infinity) position is rejected, leaving the fresh spawn in place so a corrupt blob can't load a broken world or slip past the `position.y < 2` unstuck net
- `dayClock`, `hearts`, `hunger` (all optional) — time of day and player stats, so sleeping through the night and a hurt/hungry player survive a reload
- `spawnPoint` (optional, `{x,y,z}` or null) — the bed respawn point; respawn falls back to a random land point when it is null or the block there is no longer a bed
- `blockEntities` (optional) — chest contents as `{ index, slots }[]`, keyed by the block's voxel index (the same index space as `changes`). Only **non-empty** chests are stored; an empty one carries no data and is recreated empty when opened. On load each entry is kept only if that index still holds a Chest block. This is the first per-block metadata in the format — `lib/game/save.ts` (`serializeContainers` / `readContainers`) handles it
- `effects` (optional) — active status effects as `{ id, remaining }[]` (remaining in seconds). Drink-granted buffs (Speed/Strength/Regeneration/Fire Resistance/Water Breathing) and the rotten-flesh Poison hazard live in `state.effects` (a Map) and persist here, but are **cleared on death**, so a saved-then-reloaded world resumes whatever was active at save time. - `lootedChests` (optional) — voxel indices of **worldgen** loot chests (dungeon, shipwreck, or buried treasure) the player has already opened or broken. Because an emptied chest drops out of `blockEntities`, this set — not the chest's emptiness — is what prevents a re-roll on reload. The session-only sets of _which_ indices belong to each family are not stored; they are re-derived from the seed each load via `collectDungeonSites` / `collectShipwreckSites` / `collectTreasureSites` (`lib/world/generation.ts`). The field kept its name when shipwrecks/buried treasure generalized it (state-side it is `lootedWorldgenChests`), so pre-aquatic saves read unchanged. Counters live in `state.stats` (a `Map<string, number>`) and are folded in at the engine's single emit chokepoint (`recordEvent`/`recordTick`, `lib/game/engine/systems/advancements.ts`). Like `xp` and **unlike `effects`**, they are a long-term record and are **kept across death**. Only positive values are written; `restoreStats` (`lib/game/save.ts`) drops non-string ids and negative/garbage values. The id set is open (per-recipe `crafted_<id>` and per-block `*_mined` counters), so there's no allow-list
- `advancements` (optional) — the unlocked **advancement** ids as `string[]`. Unlock is uniform — `state.stats.get(stat) >= threshold` for each declarative entry in `ADVANCEMENTS` (`lib/game/engine/systems/advancements.ts`) — and ids accumulate in `state.advancements` (a `Set`). Also **kept across death**; `restoreAdvancements` (`lib/game/save.ts`) keeps non-empty strings only, de-duplicated. Unknown persisted ids (e.g. a renamed entry) are harmless: they round-trip but never re-unlock, since `evaluateAdvancements` only iterates the registry

43:- **v17** (the players array — multiplayer groundwork) — every per-player field moves off the top level into `players: SavedPlayer[]`; world-level fields (seed, worldType, difficulty, hardcore, changes, blockEntities, lootedChests, mobs, vehicles, dayClock, villagesSeeded) stay put. `SavedPlayer` keeps the old field names (one rename: the top-level `player` position becomes `position`) so the per-field validators are shared between migration and live restores. `migrateSaveV16toV17` is a pure field move wrapping a flat single-player save as `[{ id: "local", … }]`, and rewrites pet owners from the legacy literal `"player"` to `"local"` — `SavedMob.owner` is a real player id from here on. A single-player world always saves one `"local"` entry; a multiplayer server holds one entry per known account and restores a joining player's slice through the same `restorePlayerFields` mirror that `serialize()` writes. Hardcore's `gameOver` is per-player (`restoreGameOver(save, savedPlayer)` requires the world's `hardcore` flag as before).

gh pr create --repo hutusi/monecraft --base main --head feat/account-only-online --title "Identity rework Phase 3: retire the anonymous-guest layer (accounts-only online)" --body "$(cat <<'EOF'
Completes the "Local Players vs Accounts" identity rework begun in #46: **online play now requires an email/password account**, and logged-out Local Players are purely local (unlimited browser profiles/worlds, zero server calls). This deliberately reverses the original "guests first" design and removes the anonymous layer end to end.

## What changed

- **Anonymous guest layer removed** — the better-auth `anonymous()` plugin and its `onLinkAccount` re-parenting hook, `ensureSignedIn`'s silent guest minting, the `isAnonymous` flag on `OnlineUser`/`SessionUser`, "Play online as guest", and every guest branch in the menus. Sign-in *is* the account check now, so `createProfile`'s guest guard is gone too.
- **Invite links require sign-in** — `/join/<token>` previews the world name (the invite GET stays auth-free), embeds the account panel for sign-in/register, then accepts the membership. The accept retries via a nonce-driven effect after auth changes.
- **Joined worlds are visible in account mode** — `OnlineWorldSelect` now lists the account's member-role worlds under every profile with a "Joined" tag (membership is account-level; a joined world's `profileId` is the host's). Previously an accepted invite led nowhere once the legacy guest list was gone. Joined worlds don't count against the create quota.
- **"Play locally" door** — the account home opens the local menus without signing out (with "Back to account", also reachable from the first-run form). This restores cloud-save access for accounts — the Upload/Download UI lives with the local worlds and had been unreachable in account mode since #46 — now gated on a signed-in account (`cloudEnabled`) instead of the online-used flag. The legacy "Online Worlds" section in the local world list is retired.
- **Migration `0003`** — deletes all guest users (FKs cascade their worlds, save blobs, memberships, invites) and drops `is_anonymous`. **Destructive to deployed guest data by design**; guests were cookie-bound identities. Rehearsed on PGlite: seeded guest data cascades away completely, accounts survive untouched.
- **Tests** — `lib/auth/auth.test.ts` refocuses on the remaining seam (real better-auth + drizzle on PGlite: email/password sign-up/sign-in, session shape). Both online e2e suites are rewritten as real-account journeys, closing a gap: registration, the account home, and per-profile world creation had no e2e coverage. Component tests cover the joined-worlds filter, the door, and the cloud gate. Test-only hardening: `mock.module` fakes now mirror each module's full export surface (bun can't add names to an existing module namespace, so a narrow mock in whichever file ran first could poison later imports).
- **Docs** — online.md's identity section rewritten ("Local Players and accounts"), manual/deploy/testing/tuning/README swept of guest flows; CHANGELOG carries the removal and the data-deletion warning.

No changes to the game server, tickets, protocol, or save format: `ticket.sub` stays the account id (per-profile save-slice keying deliberately deferred), and the profile already rides the ticket as name/skin.

## Deploy order (for the release notes)

Ship the app build first, then run `bun run db:migrate` — an old build errors on the dropped column, while the new build ignores it until the migration lands.

## Verification

- `bun run lint` / `typecheck` / `format:check` / `bun test` (1127 pass) / `bun run build` all green
- Full Playwright suite green (21 tests): smoke, menus, determinism, plus the rewritten two-account co-op journey and the account cloud-save round-trip through the Play-locally door
- Migration rehearsed on PGlite (0000→0003 with seeded guest + account data)
EOF
)" 2>&1 | tail -2

Redesigning the online identity model (follow-up to [[multiplayer-project]]). Approved plan: `/Users/hutusi/.claude/plans/multiplayer-is-already-working-zazzy-alpaca.md`.

**Agreed model.** "guest" → renamed **Local Player** (logged out): many local (localStorage) profiles, local single-player worlds only, zero server calls, cannot create/join/invite online. **Account** (logged in): up to **5** server-side profiles (synced across devices), each owning up to **10** online worlds; can host/invite/join. On login, local worlds are **hidden-but-preserved** (never deleted, never auto-uploaded). The anonymous-guest server layer is deleted entirely — online == you have an account (a deliberate reversal of docs/online.md "Identity: guests first").

**Everything lands on one branch `feat/local-vs-account-identity` → one PR = #46** (open, 2026-07-04). User chose to keep Phase 1 + the rest on the same PR. NOTE: the branch was first pushed as `fix/account-menu-onboarding` (PR #45); renaming it via the GitHub rename API auto-**closed** #45 (see [[github-branch-rename-closes-pr]]), so we reopened as **#46**. #45 is closed with a pointer comment.

- **Phase 1** (reported bugs) — login reachable on first-run screen + guest **Sign out**. DONE, committed. `components/menu/{ProfileSelect,AccountPanel}.tsx` (+tests), `e2e/multiplayer.e2e.ts` locator (`Create` → `exact:true`), CHANGELOG, docs/online.md.

content.text:
Phase 3 is done and shipped as **PR #47**: https://github.com/hutusi/monecraft/pull/47

**What landed** (9 commits on `feat/account-only-online`, off the merged #46):

1. **Joined worlds visible in account mode** — the exploration surfaced a gap the original plan missed: invite-joined worlds only ever appeared in the legacy guest world list, so removing guests would have made invites lead nowhere. `OnlineWorldSelect` now lists member-role worlds under every profile with a "Joined" tag, without counting them against the create quota.
2. **"Play locally" door** — account home ↔ local menus without signing out. This also fixes a regression #46 shipped: signed-in accounts had lost all access to cloud saves (the UI lives in the local world list). Cloud sync is now gated on a signed-in account via a `cloudEnabled` prop.
3. **Invite page requires an account** — preview the world name, sign in/register inline, accept. Still "deliberately unmagical", no profile pick on the page.
4. **Legacy guest "Online Worlds" section retired** from the local world list.
5. **Anonymous layer removed** — plugin, `onLinkAccount`, `ensureSignedIn`, `isAnonymous`, and every guest UI branch; `auth.test.ts` refocused on the real better-auth/drizzle seam.
6. **Migration 0003** — deletes guest users (cascades worlds/blobs/memberships/invites) and drops the column. I rehearsed the full 0000→0003 chain on PGlite with seeded guest + account data: guest data cascades away completely, accounts survive.
7. **Both online e2e suites rewritten as real-account journeys** — this also closes the coverage gap where registration, the account home, and per-profile world creation had no e2e at all.
8. **Docs + CHANGELOG** swept (online.md identity section rewritten, manual/deploy/testing/tuning/README), plus the stale save-format v16→v17 header as a drive-by.

**Verification**: full gate green — lint, typecheck, format:check, 1127 unit/component tests, production build, and all 21 Playwright tests including the two rewritten account journeys.

**Two things to remember at release time** (also in the PR body and memory): deploy the app **before** running `bun run db:migrate` (old builds select the dropped column), and the release notes must warn that guest-owned online worlds are deleted. One small manual check remains for your next gameplay pass: how `AccountPanel` looks rendered inside the join page's modal box.

content.content:
=== app/join/[token]/page.tsx:44
_🎯 Functional Correctness_ | _🟡 Minor_ | _⚡ Quick win_

**Retry re-fetches the invite instead of reusing the cached result.**

On `authNonce` bump (post sign-in), the effect re-runs `resolveInviteToken(token)` from scratch even though it already succeeded once. A transient failure on this second call would show "This invite link is invalid or has expired." right after the user just signed in — misleading given the invite was already validated. Separately, `state.phase` stays `"signin"` during the retry, so the "sign in to join" prompt and an already-"Signed in as …" `AccountPanel` are visible together until the retry resolves.

<details>
<summary>♻️ Cache the resolved invite and reset to loading on retry</summary>

```diff
+  const inviteRef = useRef<{ worldId: string; worldName: string } | null>(null);
+
   useEffect(() => {
```
